entities.name: Squee
entities.description: An immortal goblin, former Weatherlight cabin boy and now king of a mountain goblin clan, who is compleated by Ertai, destroyed, and chooses to return to life.

entities.name: Bulp
entities.description: Squee's large, scholarly goblin ward whom Squee sends to the surface to warn a town; he returns to find his king alive.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: A compleated former Weatherlight crewmate, risen after Squee burned him, who impersonates Bulp, compleates Squee's clan and tries to carry the Salvation Sphere and Squee to New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Spurna
entities.description: The head of the embermages, a compleated sleeper agent who stabs Squee and throws him from the platform.

entities.name: Rarp
entities.description: A goblin stone jockey crushed by a boulder and revealed as a Phyrexian sleeper agent.

entities.name: Salvation
entities.description: An ancient primal force in the form of Squee's toy sphere, which protected his soul, speaks to him in the afterlife and grants him a choice.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: The late Weatherlight captain whose form Salvation takes to comfort Squee.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: The Phyrexian praetor who found Ertai in the dark.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The Phyrexian whose spell made Squee immortal.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders who infiltrate Squee's clan.

entities.name: Goblin clan
entities.description: The goblin clan of the mountain over which Squee reigns and who are compleated.

entities.name: Squee's mountain
entities.description: The cave-system mountain where Squee's goblin clan lives and which is destroyed.

entities.name: Mana Rig
entities.description: The structure Ertai says they would visit before leaving.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: A region with small cities near Squee's mountain.

entities.name: Legacy Weapon
entities.description: An ancient weapon of which the Salvation Sphere was a part.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The skyship on which Squee served as a cabin boy.

entities.name: Mana lamps
entities.description: High-powered lamps lighting the mountain, whose overcharge destroys it.

events.summary: After a week without deaths, Squee learns from Bulp that goblin Rarp was crushed by a boulder.
events.quote: Like most goblins at any given moment, Rarp was standing in the wrong place at the wrong time and was crushed.

events.summary: Rarp, still alive, leaks black oil from his eyes, revealing himself as a Phyrexian sleeper agent.
events.quote: Rarp's eyes shot open, and Squee's stomach dropped as a thick black oil began leaking from them.

events.summary: Squee sends Bulp through a secret tunnel to warn a town that the Phyrexians are back and burns Rarp's body.
events.quote: "No, Bulp. You gotta tell them that the Phyrexians are back."

events.summary: Squee announces a celebration, planning to have the mana lamps turned off so torchlight will reveal gold-eyed sleeper agents.
events.quote: Squee hoped that a sudden influx of torchlight would allow him to see exactly how many gold-eyed sleeper agents he was dealing with.

events.summary: Spurna reveals herself as a sleeper agent, impales Squee and throws him off the platform, killing him.
events.quote: Spurna's arm had twisted and reformed into a heated metallic spike.

events.summary: Squee revives, sees the whole clan with gold-ringed eyes, and a rotting spell kills him again; the disguised Bulp is revealed to be Ertai.
events.quote: Ertai's spiked Phyrexian armor gleamed in the torchlight as the rot reached Squee's chest.

events.summary: Ertai explains how Sheoldred found him and says he wants Squee to beg for death, and reveals he took the Salvation Sphere.
events.quote: "Or maybe, I came here to make an unkillable goblin beg for death.

events.summary: Compleated goblins restrain Squee and sedate him on a table made of their fused bodies.
events.quote: One of the goblins had become a table, and Squee was shifted onto it.

events.summary: Squee awakens compleated, Ertai plans to deliver him to New Phyrexia for study, and Squee shows his new weapons.
events.quote: "You won't be a king in New Phyrexia.

events.summary: Squee declares himself compleat; his arm blade severs the rope holding boulders, which crush him and set off a chain explosion of mana lamps that destroys the mountain.
events.quote: there was a smoldering crater of stone.

events.summary: In the afterlife, Salvation, taking Sisay's form, explains that it protected Squee's soul and offers him a choice of returning or passing on.
events.quote: Or you can walk through this threshold, and your soul will finally be returned to the aether.

events.summary: Squee chooses to return to life for one more chance, and Bulp, back from his errand, finds his king alive.
events.quote: "I wanna go back, Sally, but I only want one more.

events.summary: Squee and Bulp resolve to fight the Phyrexians together.
events.quote: "If Phyrexia's back, then it's up to smart goblins like us to kick their butts and settle the score."

relations.note: He challenged the warlord and became king.
relations.quote: Squee was declared the new king.

relations.note: Squee took Bulp under his wing as a ward.
relations.quote: He'd been Squee's ward since his childhood

relations.note: Ertai killed Squee repeatedly and returns to torment him.
relations.quote: Ertai had killed Squee repeatedly out of little more than spite and curiosity.

relations.note: Sheoldred found him after Squee burned him.
relations.quote: That might've been the end of it if Sheoldred hadn't found me."

relations.note: It chose Squee for its boon and protected his soul.
relations.quote: I'd chosen you as a worthy recipient of my boon.

relations.note: Head of the embermages before revealing herself.
relations.quote: Squee sent for Spurna, head of the embermages.

relations.note: Reveals herself as a sleeper agent and attacks Squee, stabbing him and throwing him from the platform.
relations.quote: sending him plummeting to the mountain's stone floor.
